name: honcho
description: Codex plugin for Honcho automatic chat memory capture, memory tools, SDK integration guidance, CLI debugging, and SDK migrations.

interface.shortDescription: Build and debug AI agents with Honcho memory
interface.longDescription: Honcho for Codex bundles automatic chat memory capture hooks, persistent-memory MCP setup, integration workflows for Python and TypeScript applications, CLI debugging guidance, and SDK migration playbooks for Honcho v3-era projects. It supports the hosted Honcho service and self-hosted Honcho deployments that authenticate with an API key or JWT auth token.
